title: Pure Therion
summary: Pure Therion colosseum strategy centered on heavyweight galactic gladiators that Special Summon themselves from the hand by equipping fallen comrades from the graveyard. Each equipped Therion inherits its partner's unique Quick Effect, establishing versatile multi-layered negates, bounces, and board wipes under Therion Discolosseum and Endless Engine Argyro System.

summary.title: Starters
points: Therion "Lily" Borea Special Summons itself from hand by equipping a Plant or Therion from your GY, and sends 1 card from hand or field to the GY to search any Therion Spell or Trap card from your Deck.

Therion Discolosseum Field Spell adds any Therion monster from your Deck to your hand on activation, protects monsters from battle destruction by sending a Therion card or Argyro System from Deck to GY, and adds a Therion from GY to hand when a monster is destroyed by battle.
Endless Engine Argyro System sends 1 Therion card from your Deck to the GY on activation, and while in the GY, trades places with a Therion card in your GY to add that card to your hand.
Therion Charge sends 1 Therion card or Endless Engine Argyro System from your hand or face-up field to the GY to draw 2 cards.

summary.title: Opening: Therion Discolosseum + Lily Borea
steps: Activate Therion Discolosseum to search Therion "Lily" Borea from your Deck.
Normal Summon or discard a monster, or activate Endless Engine Argyro System to send Therion "King" Regulus from Deck to GY.
Special Summon Therion "Lily" Borea from your hand, targeting and equipping Therion "King" Regulus from your GY.
Activate Lily Borea's effect, sending the equipped Regulus to the GY to search Therion Stand Up! or Therion Cross.
Special Summon Therion "King" Regulus from your hand by equipping Lily Borea from your GY, establishing an omni-negate body on the field.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Therion "King" Regulus equips a Machine or Therion from GY to summon itself, and sends a Therion card from your hand or face-up field to the GY as a Quick Effect to negate the activation of an opponent's card or effect.

Therion Irregular is a Level 10 boss that Special Summons itself by equipping up to 3 Therion monsters from your GY, and sends Endless Engine Argyro System from hand or field to the GY to destroy all cards your opponent controls.
Therion "Bull" Ain equips a Warrior or Therion from GY, and destroys 1 Therion card you control and 1 card your opponent controls as an ignition effect.

Therion "Reaper" Fum equips an Aqua or Therion from GY, and targets 1 Therion card you control and 1 card your opponent controls to return them to the hand as a Quick Effect during the opponent's turn.
Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic Galaxy and Divine Dragon Knight Felgrand provide Rank 8 negation by overlaying Level 8 Therion monsters.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Therion Cross negates the activated effect of an opponent's monster on the field, and if you control Endless Engine Argyro System, banishes that monster instead.
Therion Stand Up! targets and Special Summons a Therion monster from your GY, then equips another Therion monster from your GY to it.
Therion Discolosseum prevents battle destruction and recycles fallen Therions whenever any monster is destroyed by battle.
Endless Engine Argyro System acts as the deck's primary GY enabler, loading names and looping from the GY every turn.
